snippet.title: Verum Titan Announcement Trailer #gametrailers #fpsgames #pcgaming #fps  #gametrending #gametrailer
snippet.description:
Announcement Trailer for the video-game Verum Titan.
A first-person narrative driven action game. You wake up as Carla in a hostile sci-fi world stripped of humanity, blast through an army of rogue machines, and uncover the truth joined by Romer, your loyal (and very chatty) vacuum-cleaner sidekick.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4760740/Verum_Titan/
Presskit: https://impress.games/press-kit/luca-bacilieri/verum-titan
Website: https://www.verumtitan.com/

Music by Aleix Ramon

Voice Actors: Tamara Ryan, Seth Hayes, Rowan Glade, Darragh Conway
